messages:
maria: Quick check — RC window in 1.5h. We need: version bump, changelog update, and a green CI sweep on staging. Anyone on changelog?
oliver: I can take changelog + version bump (will open the commit in 10m). tagging docs too.
alex: heads up — CI flaky on one of the e2e suites on staging. Seen this error twice in a row on mac-sim matrix.
srinivasan: which test? can you paste the failing trace?
alex: sure — failing test snippet: ```
E   AssertionError: expected session to expire after 30s
/opt/build/ci/tests/e2e/test_session_timeout.py:47
TimeoutException: process did not exit in 30s
```
alex: I'm going to rerun the specific job first, not the whole pipeline. /ci rerun job staging-e2e-mac-3
ci-bot: Build 2271/job#staging-e2e-mac-3: queued by alex. Previous run: flake (timeout).
maria: if rerun is green, we still have to keep the cutoff. Oliver when you push version bump, ping here so we can trigger the final green sweep.
oliver: pushed version bump commit `v2.4.1-bump` -> staging. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/repo/pull/4123 (changelog in the PR body).
srinivasan: thanks. I'll watch the rerun. If it flakes again, we should pin the test and open a follow-up rather than block the RC — we have a fallback policy.
alex: rerun is starting. will report back in ~8m.
ci-bot: Build 2271/job#staging-e2e-mac-3: success ✅ (rerun passed).
alex: rerun green. no other failures in the matrix so far.
maria: great — oliver can you merge the bump? we want to trigger the full green sweep after merge.
oliver: merging now.
ci-bot: Merge event: PR 4123 merged to staging by oliver. Triggering full pipeline.
ci-bot: Pipeline 2272: running full green-sweep (unit, integration, e2e).
srinivasan: I'll monitor flaky tests dashboard and set an alert if any test failure matches historical flake signatures.
maria: reminder — cutoff at +60m from now. If pipeline stays green, we do RC tag at cutoff. If any regression, we'll follow rollback/patch process. @srinivasan @alex please thumbs-up once you're satisfied. :thumbsup:
alex: thumbs-up
srinivasan: thumbs-up
maria: thanks team. I'll file the final release note and update the release board after the tag. Everyone stand by for the RC announcement.
